subject: Sunridge AI — MAP proposal: trial top-up + credits request
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya@sunridge.ai>, Ethan Lowe <ethan.lowe@sunridge.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sunridge AI — MAP proposal: trial top-up + credits request

Hi Maya / Ethan,

Great talking yesterday — thanks for the quick product walkthrough. Per our conversation, wed like to propose a short, structured MAP (mutual action plan) to bridge you from the current limited trial to a ramped pilot with predictable consumption.

Proposal (high level):
- 60 extra trial days (top-up)
- $15k worth of platform credits applied to the account (one-time)
- 30% discount on first 3 months of hosted API usage if you commit to the MAP milestones (signed SOW + integration milestone within 45 days)

Attachments: Sunridge_MAP_v3.pdf (MAP & milestones), SOW-draft.docx (scope + pricing table), usage-summary.csv (current consumption baseline)

This is an exception to our standard trial limits, so I wanted to flag it to leadership and revops for signoff. If this looks good to you, can you confirm the internal stakeholders who will sign and a target date for the kickoff so I can attach the DocuSign?

Next steps:
1) Maya/Ethan confirm internal approvers and timing.
2) Well route for expedited approval from RevOps and Sales Leadership.
3) DocuSign and go-live prep.

Thanks — excited to keep the momentum.

Best,
Jordan
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | (415) 555-0192

From: Maya Patel <maya@sunridge.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Ethan Lowe <ethan.lowe@sunridge.ai>
Date: Fri, 9 Mar 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sunridge AI — MAP proposal: trial top-up + credits request

Jordan,

Thanks — that proposal lines up with what we discussed internally. Two quick asks from our side:
1) Can you add a 90-day SLA for response times on production incidents during the MAP period?
2) Is there any flexibility on the credit structure to split the $15k into a $10k immediate credit + $5k on milestone completion?

Approvers: CTO (Ethan Lowe) + Head of Procurement (Maya Patel) — both ccd here. Target kickoff: week of March 27.

If you can confirm the split-credit option and the SLA language Ill route for a quick procurement sign-off.

Best,
Maya
Maya Patel
Head of Procurement | Sunridge AI
maya@sunridge.ai

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.coole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Mar 2028 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Sunridge AI — MAP proposal: trial top-up + credits request — need approval (SRG-2028-041)

Ben / Naomi / Marissa,

Forwarding Sunridges notes — they want a 60-day extension, $15k in credits split 10k/5k, and a short 90-day incident response SLA while theyre in the MAP. Theyre targeting kickoff the week of Mar 27.

Why Im escalating:
- Combined credits + discount + SLA carveout is outside standard AE authority.
- Companion ask: small delay in billing until milestone 1 is validated (requesting 30-day invoice defer).

Requested approvals:
- Ben: signoff on promotional credit + first-three-months discount (30%)
- Naomi: confirm revops can apply split credit and defer invoice rules; confirm legal/finance visibility
- Marissa: exec approval for SLA carveout and overall concession authority

Impact: Win would convert a high-velocity NLP customer in governance space; reasonable upside if they expand to embeddings for search.

Ive attached the MAP + SOW. If you want a quick call I can do 10–10:30 PT today.

Thanks,
Jordan

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Mar 2028 13:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Sunridge AI — MAP proposal: trial top-up + credits request — need approval (SRG-2028-041)

Jordan — I like the deal economics. Approve credit top-up $15k split (10k immediate / 5k milestone) and 30% promo discount on first three months conditioned on signed MAP + kickoff by Mar 31.

Couple of guardrails:
- Credits auto-expire 90 days after issuance unless milestone 1 achieved; no further extensions without Revenue leadership review.
- Invoice defer up to 30 days for the first billing period only; finance must be ccd on the DocuSign envelope.

Naomi  can you confirm revops can handle the split credit & auto-expiry configuration? If so Jordan, proceed to DocuSign and cc finance.

Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Sales, West | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Mar 2028 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Sunridge AI — MAP proposal: trial top-up + credits request — SRG-2028-041 — exec approval

All,

Ive reviewed. Exec approval granted for the following narrow carveouts:
- 60-day trial top-up
- $15k credits split 10k immediate / 5k on milestone 1
- 30% discount on hosted API for first three months, conditioned on signed MAP and kickoff by Mar 31
- 90-day incident response SLA limited to P1/P2 acknowledgement and targeted remediation timelines (operational playbook required)
- 30-day invoice defer for first billing only

Conditions:
1) Legal to sign the SOW with the SLA addendum attached as Exhibit A.
2) RevOps to set credits to auto-expire and configure milestone-based release.
3) Sales to include finance on DocuSign envelope and confirm go/no-go by Mar 24 if procurement needs earlier timing.

Jordan  you have authority to execute under these conditions. Please share the final DocuSign link and cc finance and legal.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
VP, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
